info.name: Real Estate Project Management API
info.description: Comprehensive API documentation for the Real Estate Project Management application. This API provides endpoints for managing projects, teams, stages, users, transactions, and more.

request.description: Authenticate user and receive access token
Set or reset user password using OTP
Retrieve all users with optional filters
Retrieve a specific user by ID
Create a new user account
Update user details (name, username, phone_no, email, image). Note: role and status cannot be updated via this endpoint
Check if user exists and send OTP for password reset
Update user status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, UNVERIFIED)
Create a new project
Retrieve all projects with optional filters
Retrieve a specific project by ID
Retrieve all projects for a specific customer
Retrieve all projects where user is a team member
Update project details
Create a new team for a project
Retrieve all teams
Retrieve a specific team by ID
Retrieve team for a specific project
Update team members
Create a new stage within a project. When members are added, they are automatically added to the project team if not already present.
Retrieve all stages for a project
Retrieve a specific stage by ID
Update stage details. New members are automatically added to the project team if not already present.
Delete (soft delete) a stage
Create a new transaction record
Retrieve all transactions for a project
Retrieve all transactions for a stage
Retrieve a specific transaction by ID
Update transaction details
Delete a transaction
Create a new request for materials/services
Retrieve all requests for a project
Retrieve a specific request by ID
Update request details
Delete a request
